body:
The path was changed because the updated version of gradle requires that all the paths specified via colon actually exists, and in `platform/android/java/settings.gradle`, the `:assetPacks` path doesn't exist since the actual path for it is `app/assetPacks`.

~~The regression you're trying to address seems to originate from forgetting to update the AAB assets directory in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a2aefab4c78273c8a2006daf28b700d427e1feeb/platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp#L282.~~
~~Can you update the assets directory path there and check if that resolves the regression?~~

Edit: nvm on the proposed fix, I misunderstood the regression. Let me investigate further.
